title: QUALIFY: filter on a window function
objectives: Say what QUALIFY does: it filters rows after the window functions are worked out
Keep the top row of each group in one query, with no subquery
Know where QUALIFY runs and what to write where it doesn't

exercises.prompt: Return each region's biggest order: region, order_id and amount, one row per region. When two orders in a region have the same amount, keep the smaller order_id. Sort by region.
hints: row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY amount DESC) numbers each region's orders, biggest first.
QUALIFY goes after WHERE, GROUP BY and HAVING, and keeps the rows where its condition is true.
North has two orders of 120.00. Add order_id to the window's ORDER BY so the tie always breaks the same way.
